name: Set Up Trim Floor Protection
intent: Drop cloth or runner along the perimeter of all trim before any painting begins. Trim is at floor level (baseboard) and wall edges (casings) so the protection is perimeter, not full-room. Used for both brush and spray methods.
doctrine: Trim floor protection installs faster than wall floor protection (1200 vs 600 SF/hr) because it's a thin perimeter strip, not full coverage. The painter just runs a drop along the wall base. Required for all methods because both brush and spray can drip or splatter at the floor-trim joint.
